COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f81-f84-variant-guidance-current-r1
COPY_ROOT_RULE: Create or use only this isolated copy. Never edit the source checkout, another task copy, live release, generated output, or deployment files.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, provider calls, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, generated output, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
MISSION: Close the documented F81/F84 source gap for selected-guidance attribution and richer hook/format/timing evidence in the existing variant/A-B workflow without creating a parallel media model or migration. Preserve existing asset_variant, content_bundle, experiment, assignment, review-bundle, publication-attribution and RLS contracts.
AUTHORITY: Read L5-verification/feature-reconciliation-execution-plan.md and L5-verification/architecture-reconciliation-current.md for the F81/F84 criteria. Do not resume any historical R5, scraper, gallery, team, storage or installer lane.
SCOPE: Audit and, if the existing contracts support it, change the authenticated variant candidate/review/performance route and the reachable dashboard surfaces. Candidate files include packages/api/src/variant-ab-contract.ts, packages/api/src/routes/variant-experiments.ts and tests, packages/dashboard/lib/api.ts, VariantExperimentManager.tsx, VariantPublishedPerformance.tsx, VariantExperimentTracking.tsx, VariantReviewCreate.tsx, VariantEvaluationReport.tsx, the model experiments page, and existing worker caption-guidance contracts/tests. Do not add a table or migration.
PROVENANCE_RULE: Accept no arbitrary client-supplied receipt. An optional source bundle must be selected from an authenticated existing bundle list or supplied as an ID that the server rechecks inside the org/model transaction. Require same org_id, model_id, matching asset or source-variant relationship, supported platform, and a server-stored captionGuidance receipt whose caption hash matches the saved variant copy. If no verified source exists, persist no attribution and render unavailable.
PERSISTENCE_RULE: Persist only bounded provenance in existing asset_variant.settings JSONB or existing content_bundle captionGuidance JSONB: server-derived bundle identity/platform/receipt fingerprint plus optional hook type, format, UTC posting-hour and timing bucket when already known from an explicit source. Never persist raw captions, provider payloads, prompt text, exemplar content, signed URLs or PII.
EVIDENCE_RULE: Do not infer unsupported hook/format/timing values. Preserve edited-caption hash invalidation, observed-versus-selected separation and explicit no-causality wording. Experiments must never publish directly; manual self-reported outcomes remain unverified learning.
UI_RULE: Make the existing candidate/review and experiment/performance surfaces show selected guidance and known hook/format/timing evidence, or a truthful unavailable/unknown state. Use real authenticated route/component callsites; helper-only or contract-only changes do not pass.
PASS_1: Changed product source must be reachable through an authenticated API route and dashboard component. A copied baseline, docs-only claim, generated output or helper-only delivery fails.
PASS_2: Behavior tests must cover valid bounded persistence/projection; cross-org, cross-model, wrong asset/source-variant, unsupported platform and mismatched caption-hash rejection; absent guidance; hook/format/hour/timing bounds; performance attribution; and truthful unavailable/unknown UI state.
PASS_3: Preserve tenant/model access, consent/approval, idempotency, replay safety, RLS assumptions and no-direct-publication behavior.
PASS_4: Run focused tests, typechecks, builds and lint for every changed package and report exact commands with real exit codes. No live provider, database or runtime action.
PASS_5: DELIVERY must include exact SOURCE_REF, COPY_ROOT, changed paths, per-file SHA-256, behavior-test names/counts, exact exits and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE, plus explicit confirmation that no deployment, installer, migration execution, database, provider, credential, permission, network, systemd or runtime action occurred.
BLOCK_RULE: If existing contracts cannot prove same-org/model/source-variant provenance without a new relation or migration, return one terminal BLOCKED naming the exact missing contract. Do not invent a migration or silently store unscoped identifiers.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: One Codex audit only. Do not loop on ACKs, unchanged PROGRESS or repeated helper-only rewrites. Every reply must correlate to this WIRE, avoid dates/clocks/timestamps for coordination, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
